newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan bolivar closes flat in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan bolivar closes flat in slow trade.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed flat at 475.75/476.75 bolivars per dollar in the first day of trade of the year, which saw some Central Bank presence, brokers said.
"There was some corporate demand but nothing big and the Central Bank was present, monitoring or participating," one trader said.
He expected the parity not to fluctuate significantly until January 15, when the market should wake up with the return of major corporate trading.

Thursday marked the implementation of a new exchange rate system by the Central Bank, whereby a new parity of 472 bolivars per dollar would depreciate by 1.32 percent a month, with bands fixed 7.5 percent either side.
